decision_body: W-140 OP-1 decided: execution/lease.rs (PanelLease idle/occupied kernel + chrome title/description validators) stays in Core, relocated out of execution/ beside the panel registry. Rationale: its only live owner is Core PanelRuntime (registry/host.rs); moving it to bitty-execution would force a Core-to-extension import, violating one-way dependencies. The run_wiring.rs split line follows: 14 lease_* tests stay, 13 move.
title: OP-1: PanelLease kernel stays in Core
